title: Ice and Fire and Neural Networks
description: A datapack which implements Hostile Neural Networks data models for many Ice and Fire mobs.
body:
This is a datapack for 1.18.2 which implements data models from Hostile Neural Networks for the various mobs from Ice and Fire. A design decision has been made to not add the trophy skulls or the dragon eggs to the loot fabricator recipes for gameplay reasons (thhe trophies have no value to you if a machine spat them out for you instead of you hunting for them yourself.)

This datapack requires Ice and Fire and Hostile Neural Networks. (HNN is not found on modrinth.)
